Method of Attack: Trojanized Telegram clones for Android that steal user messages, contacts lists, and other data by including extra malicious code packages (e.g., 'com.wsys') that exfiltrate encrypted data to a command and control server; spyware functionality that monitors changes to username, user ID, and contacts list and sends updated information to attacker-controlled C2 server
Impacted Systems: Android devices running trojanized Telegram apps
Attack Vector: Malicious apps uploaded to Google Play Store masquerading as faster Telegram alternatives
Post-screening and post-installation updates introducing malicious code
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control server URL: sg.telegrnm.org
